cause: Two long canvas exports were interrupted with exit 137 after large native-buffer accumulation. Short encoded diagnostics had not exposed this sustained-memory condition.
resolution: Periodic GC improved speed but remained insufficient: a later worker also exited 137. The final supervisor uses a fresh process per completed segment, one at a time. All rendering and encoding operations are unchanged; segment continuation is separately proved.
scope: Early memory samples were insufficient to establish full-run safety; final isolated-worker completion and complete delivery checks determine validity.
